about: drawn after Enactic's own pictures of the OpenArm 1.0 gripper (2026-11-17: openarm.dev's social-preview photo (its og:image, ogp.webp) of the bimanual OpenArm 1.0, both grippers in it, and the 1.0 documentation's gripper renders, docs.openarm.dev/1.0, its gripper pages and bill of materials): matte black printed fingers (the Library's part, the HandUMI replica of the OpenArm finger), a black motor can between bright machined aluminium end caps, the bent stainless sheet-metal brackets and the plate on the motor, the guide's stainless carriage blocks under the fingers, and the dark guide rail with its bright counterbored holes; the CAD files' own colours (finger.dae's black finger and pale carriage, hand.dae's dark rail and pale plate, link7.dae's dark can and pale caps) agree.  Not modelled: the swivel rotor and its two links (not in openarm_description's v1.0 meshes), the wrist bracket under the motor (link7.dae's, left out), the cables.

rail-black.evidence: openarm.dev's og:image photo of the OpenArm 1.0, the left gripper: the guide rail is a dark bar whose counterbored holes catch the light as bright slots, and hand.dae draws it dark (#2b2b2b, its material mat_1.010) beside the pale plate and brackets: a black-treated steel with small sharp highlights

cap-satin.evidence: openarm.dev's og:image photo of the OpenArm 1.0: the motor's end caps are bead-blasted aluminium, a soft light grey with no mirror image of the room; with the base look the rear cap's lower edge mirrored the studio's floor and read #f0f4f9 at the homes, the card's own white

can-black.evidence: openarm.dev's og:image photo of the OpenArm 1.0, both grippers: the motor can is a black satin cylinder with one broad soft highlight, between the bright aluminium flange in front of it and the wrist's bracket behind it; link7.dae draws the can dark (#2b2b2b, mat_2.005)
